verdict.rationale: Swell's backend API docs say official client libraries exist for Node and PHP, so a developer can build against first-party SDKs. The evidence is a single line, though, with no detail on SDK depth or coverage. Missing for 10: documentation of SDK features and API coverage, SDKs beyond Node and PHP (e.g. Python or a frontend/storefront SDK), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Official libraries for the Swell API are available for Node and PHP.
